title: Sign in with valid customer credentials
description: This verifies that an existing customer can sign in and reach the authenticated account area or next destination.

steps.description: Navigate to /giris
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the account area or next authenticated destination is displayed

title: Open a product detail and add it to the cart

steps.description: Navigate to /urunler
Open a product from the catalog
Select a valid product variation
Add the product to the cart
Verify the cart updates with the added item

title: Update cart quantity and totals

steps.description: Navigate to /giris

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}

Verify an order submission confirmation is visible
